topic_ko: 프랑스 교환학생 Delphine이 비 내리는 더블린에 도착해 O'Brien 가족과 첫 인사를 나누기까지

passage: Meeting people from other cultures teaches us to notice both what we share and what we do not.
A French student named Delphine flew to Dublin in March to stay with an Irish family for two weeks.
She hoped to practise her English and to see something of the world beyond her own country.
On the drive from the airport the rain came and went so quickly that a single hour felt like four seasons.
The strange weather did not trouble her, because a lively Irish song was playing in the car.
At the house the younger children looked as shy as she felt.
She greeted them in Irish, and they answered in Irish too, stumbling over the words.
After that small exchange the distance between them was noticeably shorter.
choices: the practical difficulties of travelling abroad as a teenager
how a first greeting in a host country's own language eases strangeness
the reasons Irish weather changes more often than French weather
the advantages of learning English in an English-speaking country
the role of traditional folk music in Irish family life
theme.explanation_ko: 낯선 날씨와 낯선 사람들 사이의 어색함이 아일랜드어 인사 한 번으로 좁혀지는 흐름이므로 ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 여행의 실무적 어려움은 다루지 않는다. ③ 날씨는 낯섦을 보여 주는 장치일 뿐 프랑스와 비교하지 않는다. ④ 영어 연습은 방문 동기의 하나로만 언급된다. ⑤ 민요는 분위기를 전할 뿐 주제가 아니다.

passage: Delphine travelled from Lyon to Dublin in March to spend a fortnight with the O'Briens.
She wanted to improve her English, but she also wanted to widen her view of the world.
The drive home brought drizzle, clear sky and heavy rain within a single hour.
None of it bothered her, for a cheerful Irish folk song filled the car.
Inside the terraced house, four younger children watched her without speaking.
They looked shy, and a little nervous, exactly as she did.
Then the guest offered a greeting in Irish, and the children replied in the same language.
Awkward as the words were, everyone in the room felt closer once they were spoken.
choices: 해외 생활은 언어 실력보다 날씨 적응이 더 어렵다.
낯선 가정에 머무를 때는 예의를 갖추는 것이 가장 중요하다.
민속 음악은 낯선 문화를 이해하는 가장 빠른 통로이다.
교환학생은 도착 직후 현지 언어를 완벽히 익혀야 한다.
서툴더라도 상대의 언어로 건넨 인사가 낯선 사이의 거리를 좁힌다.
gist.explanation_ko: 어색한(awkward) 발음이었음에도 인사를 주고받은 뒤 서로 가까워졌다고 맺으므로 ⑤가 요지이다.
gist.distractor_ko: ① 날씨는 성가시지 않았다고 했다. ② 예의 자체를 논하지 않는다. ③ 음악은 배경일 뿐이다. ④ '완벽히 익혀야 한다'는 주장은 없고 오히려 서툰 인사가 통했다.

passage: In March a French student arrived in Dublin to spend two weeks with an Irish host family.
Rain, sunshine and downpour followed one another so fast that an hour held every season.
She was not troubled by it, since a cheerful folk song was playing on the car radio.
The car stopped before a cosy terraced house where four younger children waited.
They looked shy, and so did she.
She spoke first, in Irish, though the language was not hers.
The children smiled and answered awkwardly in the same tongue.
From that moment the room felt warmer to everyone in it.
choices: Four Seasons in an Hour: Irish Weather Explained
Why Every Student Should Study Abroad
Eight Words in Irish: How a Greeting Broke the Ice
The History of Irish Folk Music
A Guide to Host Families in Dublin
title.explanation_ko: 글의 결정적 장면이 아일랜드어 인사 한마디로 어색함이 풀린 순간이므로 ③이 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ① 날씨는 도입부 소재일 뿐이다. ② 유학 권유가 아니다. ④ 민요는 한 번 스칠 뿐이다. ⑤ 안내문 성격의 글이 아니다.

passage: Delphine had come from Lyon to spend two weeks with an Irish family.
On the way home the sky drizzled, cleared and poured within a single hour.
Although quite new to Delphine, the changeable weather did not bother her.
A cheerful Irish folk song was playing on the radio as they drove.
Inside the house, two younger boys and two younger girls were waiting.
They looked shy and a little nervous.
She greeted them in Irish, and they replied awkwardly in Irish as well.
After greeting each other in Irish, they felt closer.
implication.underlined: Although quite new to Delphine, the changeable weather did not bother her.
choices: The unfamiliar weather failed to spoil her mood on that first day.
She had already grown used to sudden rain before arriving in Ireland.
The weather was so mild that nobody in the car noticed it at all.
She disliked the rain but chose to hide her feelings from the family.
The changing sky reminded her of the climate she had left behind.
implication.explanation_ko: '낯설었지만 성가시게 하지 않았다'는 것은 낯선 날씨가 첫날의 기분을 망치지 못했다는 뜻이므로 ①이 맞다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② quite new 라고 했으므로 익숙하지 않았다. ③ 날씨가 온화했다는 서술이 아니라 변덕스러웠다. ④ 싫었지만 숨겼다는 근거가 없다. ⑤ 프랑스 날씨와 비교하지 않았다.

passage: Delphine left Lyon in March to spend two weeks with an Irish family in Dublin.
She wanted to practise English and to broaden her horizons by living abroad.
The drive home brought drizzle, clear sky and heavy rain within a single hour.
The changeable weather did not bother her, as a cheerful folk song played in the car.
Four younger children met her inside the house, shy and a little nervous.
She greeted them first, in Irish, a language she barely knew.
They smiled and answered awkwardly in the same language.
After that exchange everyone in the room felt closer.
summary.summary_template: Although everything about Delphine's first day in Dublin was __(A)__ to her, an imperfect greeting in the family's own language made the household feel __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 날씨도 사람도 모두 낯설었으나(unfamiliar) 서툰 아일랜드어 인사 뒤 서로 가까워졌으므로(closer) ⑤가 맞다.
summary.distractor_ko: familiar 는 quite new 라는 서술과 어긋나고, stricter·quieter 는 '더 가까워졌다'는 결말과 맞지 않는다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 아일랜드어로 서로 인사를 나눈 뒤, 그들은 더 가까워졌다고 느꼈다.
writing.answer: After greeting each other in Irish, they felt closer.
writing.explanation_ko: After 가 전치사로 쓰였으므로 뒤에 동명사 greeting 이 오고, each other 는 "서로"라는 상호대명사이다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오. (총 11단어)
writing.ko_prompt: 그것은 단 한 시간 만에 사계절을 모두 겪는 것 같았다.
writing.answer: It was like having all four seasons in just an hour.
writing.explanation_ko: 전치사 like 뒤에는 동명사가 온다. It was like having all four seasons in just an hour. 로 11단어이다.

writing.question: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 넣어 문장을 완성하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그녀는 해외에서 생활함으로써 자신의 시야를 넓히고 싶었다.
writing.template: She wanted to broaden her horizons ______ ______ abroad.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Although quite new to Delphine, the changeable weather did not bother her.
writing.answer: Delphine에게는 꽤 낯설었지만, 그 변덕스러운 날씨는 그녀를 성가시게 하지 않았다.
writing.explanation_ko: Although 뒤에 it was 가 생략된 양보절이다. bother 는 "성가시게 하다"이다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: The __(A)__ weather and the silent children made everything feel strange, but after greeting each other in Irish they felt __(B)__.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문은 날씨를 changeable 이라 했고, 인사를 주고받은 뒤 felt closer 라고 맺는다.

writing.question: 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 상대의 언어로 건넨 짧은 인사가 낯선 사람들 사이를 가깝게 만든다.
writing.answer: A short greeting in someone else's language can bring strangers closer.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어를 greeting 으로 두고 bring A closer 구조를 쓰면 간결하다.
